services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: The Dairy’s largest theater seats up to 244 patrons. Equipped with sprung Marley dance flooring, this theater is primarily used for dance rehearsals and performances. The Dairy’s second largest theater seats up to 114 patrons. Equipped with a wood floor, clients can build theater sets in this theater. This theater is primarily used for two to five-week periods for major theater productions. The Dairy’s Black Box theater is completely configurable, and can be arranged to the client’s liking, with up to 68 seats for patrons.
